excluded.name: Yahoo Finance MCP servers (yfinance-based)
excluded.reason: Excluded from published examples on data rights: Yahoo Finance data is licensed for personal use, and the MIT licence of the wrapper code does not grant redistribution or public educational-display rights. Fine for private exploration; never a source for this repository's reports.

excluded.name: Financial Datasets MCP
excluded.reason: Not free: no free tier (paid credit packs; redistribution requires a Professional plan). Fails the free-composition brief.

excluded.name: World Bank MCP wrappers (community)
excluded.reason: The World Bank Open Data API is free and keyless and is used directly by this repository's report generator, but the community MCP wrappers surveyed had no clear licence or thin maintenance. Revisit if a well-licensed wrapper appears.

note: Curated composition set: free MCP servers that pair with FinancialLibrary's curated records to give teachers live, official financial data. Servers are referenced by configuration only — none is vendored into this repository. Each user supplies their own API keys; never commit a key. Educational only, not financial advice.

servers.classroom_use: The explainer layer: who the FDIC, the Federal Reserve or a deposit insurer is, and where to check a claim.
servers.name: FinancialLibrary MCP (this server)
servers.role: Curated financial-literacy records: official resources and vehicle explainers across 16 countries, with source URLs and freshness dates.

servers.api_key: Free FRED API key required — each user registers their own at https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/api_key.html (120 requests/minute)
servers.classroom_use: This week's policy rate and inflation print, set against the library's US records (us-federal-reserve, us-fdic-deposit-insurance).
servers.data_source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (official API)
servers.license: AGPL-3.0 (server code) — run unmodified as a separate process; do not vendor a modified fork without an AGPL review
servers.name: FRED MCP Server (Stefano Amorelli)
servers.role: Live US macro data: policy rate, CPI, unemployment, Treasury yields, saving rate — the full FRED catalogue of 800,000+ series.

servers.api_key: Free FRED API key required (your own key)
servers.classroom_use: Drop-in replacement for the `fred` entry in the composed configs.
servers.data_source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (official API)
servers.name: FRED MCP Server (Florian Caro) — MIT alternative
servers.role: Same FRED slot as `fred`, for users who prefer an MIT-licensed server: 33 granular tools over FRED and GeoFRED, install via pip (`pip install fred-mcp-server`).

servers.api_key: none — a declared SEC_EDGAR_USER_AGENT (name + email) is required; respect SEC fair access (under 10 requests/second)
servers.classroom_use: Read one real bank's latest 10-K balance sheet and find the deposits line the FDIC insures (record us-fdic-deposit-insurance).
servers.license: AGPL-3.0 (server code) — run unmodified as a separate process
servers.name: SEC EDGAR MCP (Stefano Amorelli)
servers.role: Real company filings: CIK lookup, 10-K / 10-Q / 8-K retrieval and section extraction, XBRL financial statements, insider transactions.

servers.classroom_use: Compare inflation across the library's 16 countries from one official multilateral source. Small project — pin a reviewed commit rather than tracking main.
servers.name: IMF Data MCP (c-cf)
servers.notes: IMF data terms for classroom republication were not verified at curation time — check https://www.imf.org/en/About/copyright-and-terms before republishing figures.
servers.role: Multilateral macro data across the library's countries: CPI, national accounts, balance of payments, monetary and financial statistics (~155 IMF databases via the SDMX API).

servers.api_key: Free key required — free tier is 25 API requests/day, so batch and cache; real-time US market data is premium-only
servers.classroom_use: One company's statements plus the federal funds series in a single worksheet — the licensed substitute for Yahoo Finance data in published examples.
servers.license: MIT (server code); data display follows Alpha Vantage plan terms
servers.name: Alpha Vantage MCP Server (official)
servers.role: Licensed market and fundamentals data: quotes, statements, earnings, economic indicators, news sentiment.

servers.classroom_use: ECB deposit-facility rate and HICP inflation for Germany, France and Italy, read against the library's EdB, FGDR and FITD deposit-insurance records.
servers.data_source: ECB Statistical Data Warehouse and Eurostat (official, no auth)
servers.name: EU Finance MCP (NexusForge) — pilot
servers.notes: Free during the vendor's beta with a paid tier announced — pilot only, not a load-bearing dependency.
servers.role: Euro-area data with no key: ECB policy rates, EUR exchange rates, Eurostat HICP inflation, GDP and unemployment.

servers.api_key: Per provider (e.g. a free FRED key for the FRED provider)
servers.classroom_use: An advanced class builds one normalised multi-provider dashboard behind a single endpoint. Pin versions and restrict served categories.
servers.data_source: Whichever providers are installed — each keeps its own key and terms
servers.license: Apache-2.0 per project README (verify the LICENSE file before vendoring)
servers.name: OpenBB Open Data Platform MCP — advanced alternative
servers.role: Aggregator: one MCP endpoint whose tools are generated from installed provider packages (FRED, IMF, Cboe and more). An alternative to the standalone servers, not an addition to them.
